Mission Brief 

Isar Aerospace is building Spectrum, a European launch vehicle developed and tested in Germany. Engineering, testing and operations all need time with our CTO, so the CTO’s time is one of the most requested resources in the company. How well it’s organised directly affects how quickly technical and operational topics move forward.

That’s where you come in. You’ll run the CTO’s calendar, travel and meeting preparation, and make sure that what’s agreed in a meeting actually happens afterwards. You report to the Chief of Staff, who leads the content of meetings. You take care of everything around them and keep the Chief of Staff updated on what’s happening in the technical organisation.

 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Run the CTO’s calendar. Schedule and reschedule, handle the daily flow of requests, and keep the week realistic. A big part of this is balancing the CTO’s time between technology and operations, with priorities agreed with the Chief of Staff.
  • Prepare the meetings that matter, and follow them through. Decide with the Chief of Staff which internal, executive, technical and partner meetings take place. Prepare agendas, pre-reads and briefing packs, then follow up on every decision and action item until it’s done.
  • Keep the commitment log for the CTO Office. Track open topics and decisions, flag anything at risk early, and make sure nothing gets forgotten.
  • Keep the CTO Office routines running. Plan leadership meetings, technical reviews, offsites and selected company-wide events well in advance.
  • Plan travel end to end: bookings, itineraries, documents and approvals, and expense reports afterwards.
  • Get leadership materials ready to send. Collect inputs, keep numbers and formatting consistent, and give PowerPoint presentations and reports a final check before they go out.
  • Keep information moving and fix what’s stuck. Make sure information flows both ways between the CTO Office and the rest of the company. Spot bottlenecks and either solve them or raise them with a proposal.
  • Support special projects and improve how we work. Help with initiatives led by the Chief of Staff, from scoping to completion, and leave the CTO Office’s processes and templates better documented than you found them.

 

Qualification Checklist 

  • Several years as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant or in a similar role supporting senior leaders. Experience in a CEO or CTO office is a strong advantage.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany. 

The Opportunity:

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.

The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer to help build the first production services for this context layer management system. You will design and ship the core backend architecture that powers ingestion, context storage, retrieval APIs, and agent-facing integrations. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

What You'll Be Doing: 

  • Build the core backend services: Design, implement, test, and operate the first services for context ingestion, context indexing, retrieval orchestration, API access, source configuration, and system administration.
  • Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.
  • Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and service interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve relevant context, provenance, confidence signals, and warnings.
  • Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.
  • Operate what you build: Instrument services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
  • Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.
  • Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
  • Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows. 

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory. 
  • Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.
  • Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined. 
  • Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.
  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and building applications powered by GenAI.
  • Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users. 
  • Exposure to working in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.

Bonus Points for:

  • Experience building or working with agent frameworks or multi‑agent workflows.
  • Experience as a data analyst or work with data platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Snowflake, DataBricks)
  • Experience building tools for data engineering. 

How we work:

We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our Staff engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.

You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Industrial companies hold millions of spare parts, and many more are available from resellers, distributors, and the companies that build production lines. Your mission is to connect these worlds. You will build SPARETECH's supply network: the partners who sell parts to our customers and the partners who buy parts from them.

You will define how we work with resellers, distributors, and line builders, win them as partners, and turn these partnerships into new ways for manufacturers to find, buy, and sell the parts that keep their production running.

We offer you the opportunity to

  • Build a new channel from the ground up: Shape SPARETECH's partnership strategy for resellers, distributors, and line builders.
  • Win strategic partners: Lead partner acquisition from first conversation to signed agreement.
  • Design the deal: Develop value propositions and commercial models that work for our partners and our customers.
  • Shape what we build: Work with Product and Engineering to bring partner offerings into the SPARETECH platform.
  • Create value in both directions: Help our customers buy the parts they need and sell the parts they no longer use.
  • Take real ownership: Work closely with leadership in a role where your strategy and execution are visible.
  • Work remote-first: Work from within Germany as part of an international team.

Become a part of the team if you

  • Bring experience: Have 6+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, channel management, or key account management.
  • Know the industry: Have worked in or with manufacturing, industrial distribution, automation, or OEM after-sales.
  • Close partnerships: Have structured and negotiated commercial partnerships with senior stakeholders.
  • Think and execute: Can design a partnership approach from scratch and run it hands-on.
  • Stay persistent: Enjoy long sales cycles and building trust over time.
  • Speak fluently: Are fluent in German and English (C1 or higher).

You can expect

  • A dynamic start-up atmosphere and an international team in which new ideas, creative approaches, and cooperation at eye level are valued

About SPARETECH

SPARETECH's vision is to empower the zero-waste industrial sharing economy by enabling maintenance and procurement teams at manufacturing leaders like Bosch, Porsche, and Nestlé to reduce MRO spend and optimize inventory through accurate part information, internal transparency, and market visibility.

To achieve this, we have built, and continue to build, an AI-powered MRO software that connects all players in the spare parts ecosystem, from manufacturers and suppliers to the people working behind the machines. By facilitating the exchange of data, knowledge, and expertise, we create shared visibility that empowers smarter decisions, reduces waste, and drives seamless collaboration. This connected spare parts intelligence unlocks value that extends far beyond software.

Backed by Insight Partners, SPARETECH is accelerating its growth with a strong focus on product innovation and team excellence. We take pride in our inclusive and collaborative culture, as well as our energetic and committed team.

Scopely is looking for a Senior Producer to join the Live Game organisation supporting the MONOPOLY GO! team. This role is remote within the UK and will support our Barcelona and Sevilla hubs.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and strive to inspire play every day—through our work alongside talented colleagues and through our connection with millions of players around the world.

MONOPOLY GO! is one of Scopely’s flagship mobile free-to-play franchises and one of the largest games in the mobile industry. 

With teams distributed across Barcelona, Sevilla, the United States, and other global locations, this role requires strong production leadership, excellent communication, and exceptional attention to detail.

About the Role

As a Senior Producer within the Live Game organization, you will oversee development across one or more live game workstreams, helping transform product strategy and creative goals into high-quality player experiences.

You will manage development from early planning and team alignment through implementation, integration, QA, release, and live support. This includes coordinating concurrent initiatives, managing complex dependency chains, driving change request flow, and ensuring teams remain focused on delivering meaningful player and business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, in-the-weeds production role requiring both strategic thinking and tactical execution. You will work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Art, Content, Economy, QA, Localization, Analytics, Live Operations, and Release Management to deliver at the pace and quality expected of a global mobile live-service game.

What You Will Do

  • Own the end-to-end production lifecycle for assigned Live Game development workstreams, from discovery and planning through development, release, and post-launch support.
  • Manage multiple concurrent initiatives with shared teams, resources, dependencies, and shifting priorities.
  • Translate product strategy and roadmap objectives into clear, executable development plans.
  • Build and maintain integrated schedules, milestone plans, critical paths, risk registers, and dependency maps.
  • Coordinate development across Product, Game Design, Engineering, Art, Content, Economy, QA, Localization, Analytics, Live Operations, and Release Management.
  • Establish clear DRIs, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision points, and delivery expectations for major initiatives.
  • Manage the complete mobile live-service development lifecycle, including design alignment, implementation, configuration, integration, QA validation, release readiness, live activation, and post-launch follow-up.
  • Partner with Live Operations and Release Management to ensure development work is compatible with the LiveOps calendar, release cadence, player priorities, and operational requirements.
  • Lead the change request process by assessing the impact of proposed changes on scope, schedule, capacity, quality, risk, and downstream dependencies.
  • Drive prioritization and decision-making around change requests, communicate approved changes clearly, and ensure plans and systems remain aligned with the latest direction.
  • Proactively identify blockers, bottlenecks, gaps in ownership, and risks to delivery. Resolve issues directly where possible and escalate with clear recommendations when necessary.
  • Facilitate milestone reviews, sprint planning, production checkpoints, risk reviews, and cross-functional working sessions.
  • Ensure meetings result in clear decisions, owners, deadlines, and follow-through.
  • Maintain accurate and current project information across Jira, Airtable, Confluence, and other production systems.
  • Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery confidence clearly to both senior leadership and development teams across the Barcelona and Sevilla hubs.
  • Partner with Live Operations after launch to support issue triage, player-impacting investigations, post-launch actions, and continuous improvement.
  • Use player data, team feedback, and operational insights to inform prioritization and improve future development planning.
  • Champion improvements to development workflows, production practices, tooling, and cross-functional collaboration across the Live Game organization.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in game production, with significant experience in mobile free-to-play or live-service games.
  • Proven experience managing the development and delivery of mobile game features, systems, content, events, or other player-facing experiences.
  • Strong understanding of Live Operations, including high-frequency content delivery, live calendars, release cycles, remote configuration, QA validation, launch readiness, and post-launch support.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent development workstreams with complex cross-functional dependencies.
  • Strong understanding of roadmap planning, milestone management, critical-path tracking, risk management, change management, and delivery readiness.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering and technical teams, with an understanding of client/server dependencies, configuration, integration, and mobile release considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage dependency escalation, negotiate tradeoffs, and create accountability across teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to bring clarity to complex or ambiguous situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership for the quality and accuracy of production information.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Airtable, Confluence, Google Workspace, or similar project-management systems.
  • Ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels, from shaping a development roadmap to following individual deliverables through completion.
  • A player-focused mindset and passion for building engaging, polished, and continuously evolving mobile game experiences.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Is highly organized, structured, dependable, and comfortable operating in a high-volume Live Operations environment.
  • Understands the realities of mobile free-to-play development, including rapid iteration, global releases, frequent content updates, live player impact, and operational precision.
  • Drives outcomes beyond task tracking and status reporting.
  • Anticipates problems before they become delivery issues.
  • Communicates directly, diplomatically, and consistently across global teams and time zones.
  • Creates accountability without unnecessary process or bureaucracy.
  • Is comfortable challenging unclear plans, identifying gaps, and driving decisions.
  • Can manage competing priorities while maintaining focus on the critical path.
  • Brings sound judgment, energy, and a collaborative mindset to a fast-paced, globally distributed development organization.
  • Cares deeply about both the quality of the player experience and the operational excellence required to deliver it.

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

The role 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Agentic Search team, building the search and retrieval infrastructure that powers AI agents and LLM-based applications at scale.

This is a hands-on IC role with real ownership. You will take full end-to-end responsibility over a core product area, from defining strategy through shipping and iterating based on real usage data. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, design, and go-to-market, shaping how AI agents discover, retrieve, and act on web information in real time.

The product serves both a developer-facing PLG motion and a growing enterprise customer base, so you will need to be equally comfortable digging into API design and search quality as you are running customer discovery calls and informing competitive positioning. We are looking for someone who can operate as a senior strategic partner, not just an executor, and who has the potential to grow into a principal-level PM over time.

You’re welcome to work hybrid from Tel Aviv, Israel.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own a core product area end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, execution, and iteration based on real usage signals and customer feedback.
  • Drive search quality and relevance improvements by working closely with engineering and research to define evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and release criteria.
  • Engage directly with enterprise customers and developer users to validate ideas, understand pain points, and shape product-market fit across both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape in agentic search and AI-powered retrieval, identifying shifts, threats, and opportunities that should inform product decisions.
  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams (sales, solutions, growth) to ensure product positioning, ICP definitions, and enablement materials reflect product reality.
  • Contribute to product strategy as a senior voice on a small, high-impact team, challenging assumptions and bringing independent judgment to key decisions.
  • Lead product experiments and rapid iteration cycles, moving from hypothesis to prototype to production with clear success criteria.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in developer tools, API platforms, or search and retrieval infrastructure.
  • Track record of shipping products in fast-moving markets, working closely with engineering and design from concept through launch and iteration.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows. Hands-on technical background is a strong plus.
  • Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity: you can context-switch between strategic thinking and tactical execution without losing the thread.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment without formal authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Experience in search, information retrieval, NLP, or adjacent domains.
  • Background in API-first or developer-platform businesses with both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.
  • People management or mentoring experience (building the skills of other PMs).

description: About us Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland. About the role As the Senior Product Manager on our AI team, you'll own how AI shows up in Tebi, from an AI agent embedded in the product to the AI capabilities that run through the platform. Tebi sits on a unified foundation of sales, payments, reservations, kitchen and inventory data, which gives our AI something most restaurant software can't offer: the full picture. You'll own the vision, strategy and roadmap, and turn that data into agents and features that save merchants time, cut costs and help them make better decisions on a busy service. What you’ll do: Define and own the vision and roadmap for Tebi's AI agent and AI capabilities across the product. Work with AI engineers and data teams to ship agentic features that take real actions for merchants, not just answer questions. Spend time with restaurant owners, managers and staff, plus Sales and Customer Success, to find the jobs where AI genuinely removes friction in their day. Define how we measure quality and trust in AI features, including evals, accuracy, adoption and merchant outcomes, and use that to iterate quickly. Decide where AI belongs in the product and where it doesn't, including guardrails, human-in-the-loop moments and when the merchant makes the final call. Partner with all the other product teams so AI feels native to Tebi rather than bolted on. What you'll need: 8+ years of product management experience at a fast-growing tech company, with a track record of shipping impactful launches. You are highly collaborative, able to partner effectively across the organization and build trust with both technical and operational teams. Hands-on experience building AI-powered products and a solid grasp of their strengths and limits. A data-driven mindset: you combine quantitative signals and qualitative feedback, and you know how to evaluate non-deterministic products. You care about the balance between craft, speed, and outcomes. This probably isn't the role for you if you're happiest on a structured environment with clear directions. We are looking for someone to set the direction and the vision for this team. People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers. Benefits: Generous start-up equity Competitive Salary Lunch provided in the office Team building events Unlimited time off What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don't. It's a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it's a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How We Use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn't make the last call. description: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel Ben jij een ondernemende Product Manager die kansen ziet waar anderen ze nog niet zien? Krijg jij energie van het doorgronden van complexe productieprocessen en weet je deze te vertalen naar slimme, innovatieve softwareoplossingen? Wil jij de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, richting te geven aan productontwikkeling en écht impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische organisatie? Dan is dit jouw kans! Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Product Manager LogicSteel ben jij dé drijvende kracht achter het doorgronden van productieprocessen en het vertalen daarvan naar slimme oplossingen binnen LogicSteel. LogicSteel is ons cloud-based software platform voor de staalverwerkende industrie. Middels LogicSteel wordt de ontwerpfase, werkvoorbereiding en productie naadloos met elkaar verbonden. Wat kunnen klanten uit LogicSteel halen? Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het automatisch plannen en inkopen van al het materiaal voor productie, het optimaliseren van het proces voor nesting op basis van voorraad en beschikbaarheid, het realtime volgen van het volledige productieproces én het aansturen van onze machines. In deze sleutelrol duik jij in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers. Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk, staat dicht bij de klant en verdiept je in de stappen en randvoorwaarden voor hun productieproces. Door regelmatig klanten in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken, krijg je scherp inzicht in de productieprocessen, knelpunten en kansen voor optimalisatie. Hierbij doorgrond je welke stappen bepalend zijn, welke beperkingen een limitatie vormen en waar liggen kansen om slimmer te werken? Deze inzichten vertaal je naar generieke, herbruikbare product-capabilities die in verschillende processen waarde toevoegen – van 3D-modeling tot machinebewegingen. Vervolgens werk je initiatieven uit tot concrete productrequirements waarmee Product Owners aan de slag kunnen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met multidisciplinaire teams om te zorgen dat software, processen en machines naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. In deze rol houd je continu grip op de voortgang, kwaliteit en impact van LogicSteel-oplossingen, en stuur je waar nodig bij om het beste resultaat te behalen. Maar dat is nog niet alles. Als Product Manager LogicSteel bewaak jij de samenhang binnen het platform. Je zorgt ervoor dat processen, knelpunten, afhankelijkheden en product-capabilities goed worden vastgelegd en gecommuniceerd, zodat Product Owners, engineering en consultancy vanuit hetzelfde beeld werken. Je communiceert helder over de gemaakte keuzes, stemt af met betrokken teams en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een samenhangend LogicSteel-platform. Daarnaast draag je actief bij aan productintroducties en de doorontwikkeling van onze software-oplossingen. Samenvattend bestaan jouw verantwoordelijkheden uit het: doorgronden en structureren van complexe productieprocessen bij staalverwerkende organisaties; bezoeken van (internationale) klanten om processen te begrijpen en nieuwe kansen te identificeren; vertalen van pijnpunten en klanbehoeften naar generieke herbruikbare product-capabilities, van 3D modeling tot machinebewegingen; identificeren waar vergelijkbare capabilities in verschillende processen kunnen worden toegepast; bepalen welke functionaliteiten en innovaties worden ontwikkeld; opstellen van een helder werkpakket met productrequirements voor de Product Owners en het bewaken van de voortgang; intensief samenwerken met Product Owners, Engineers en Consultants om software, processen en machines optimaal op elkaar te laten aansluiten; bewaken van de samenhang binnen LogicSteel en het consistent vastleggen van klantprocessen, knelpunten en capabilities; bijdragen aan succesvolle productintroducties en doorontwikkeling. Wat maakt deze functie zo bijzonder? “Je bent een ondernemer binnen onze onderneming”, aldus collega Luc. Jij verdiept je in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers en ontdekt waar complexe stappen, beperkingen en afhankelijkheden om slimme oplossingen vragen. Je weet die processen te doorgronden en te vertalen naar herbruikbare capabilities die niet alleen één klant helpen, maar binnen het gehele LogicSteel-platform van waarde zijn. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met verschillende disciplines en bouw je dagelijks aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen! Warm en professioneel bad Bij ons werk je niet zomaar voor een bedrijf, maar voor een familiebedrijf waar mensen centraal staan. Je merkt het in alles: de korte lijnen, de betrokkenheid en de ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen. Ondernemerschap zit in het DNA van de organisatie. Heb je een goed idee? Dan krijg je de vrijheid en het vertrouwen om dit verder te brengen en écht impact te maken. Daarnaast kennen we elkaar, nemen we verantwoordelijkheid en staan we voor elkaar klaar. Dat zie je terug in de manier waarop we samenwerken: teams trekken veel met elkaar op, denken over domeinen heen en zoeken actief de verbinding. Die open en ondersteunende houding zorgt niet alleen voor sterke resultaten, maar ook voor een werksfeer waarin je je snel thuis voelt. Zoals een collega het mooi zegt: “Doordat we er voor elkaar zijn, kunnen we kwaliteit leveren én zorgen we voor een prettige werksfeer – met ruimte voor een gezonde dosis humor en gezelligheid.” Tegelijkertijd is er veel aandacht voor jouw persoonlijke groei. We kijken naar talent, potentie en kwaliteit, en bieden ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en stappen te zetten. Of zoals collega Luc het verwoordt: “Ik ben als stagiaire begonnen en heb de kans gekregen om door te groeien tot eindverantwoordelijke voor de business unit LogicSteel. Kortom, binnen ons bedrijf is veel mogelijk.” Wij vragen Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in Industrial Engineering & Management / Technische Bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Software Engineering, Business IT & Management of een vergelijkbare richting; Relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie; Het vermogen om complexe (productie)processen te ontrafelen, te structureren en inzichtelijk te maken; Een sterk abstractievermogen en het talent om generieke capabilities te herkennen die ook in andere processen bruikbaar zijn; Sterke analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om processen en afhankelijkheden te vertalen naar heldere, concrete productrequirements; Het vermogen om de samenhang tussen verschillende onderdelen van een softwareplatform te overzien en te bewaken; Het talent om overzicht te behouden omtrent de productontwikkeling; Het vermogen om helder af te stemmen, intern draagvlak te creëren en effectief samen te werken met Product Owners, engineers en consultants; Kennis van productieprocessen in de staalbouw, werkvoorbereiding en/of calculatie is een sterke pre; Een nieuwsgierige, proactieve mindset en de drive om complexe processen steeds slimmer in te richten; Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal; Wij bieden Een brutosalaris tussen €5.301 en €7.460 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring; 40 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband; Flexibele werktijden voor een goede werk-privébalans; Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze commerciële productstrategie met internationale impact; Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen; Ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatieven binnen een ambitieus team; Dagelijks een heerlijke lunch in bedrijfsrestaurant Steely’s; Uitstekende doorgroeimogelijkheden en ontwikkelkansen. Ben jij dé Senior Product Manager MRP die we zoeken? Solliciteer dan nu en bouw mee aan onze producten! description:
About Electra

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.

The Role

Electra seeks an experienced Program Manager to lead the planning and execution of a European tour for Electra's EL2 technology demonstrator aircraft. This role will serve as the primary team lead for the EL2 program, partnering closely with engineering, flight test, government and commercial stakeholders, and company leadership to ensure the tour achieves its strategic objectives safely, on schedule, and within budget. After the completion of the European tour this role will transition to supporting EL9.  The exact nature of this support will depend on the candidates specific skills and interest areas; likely options include test team program management, program office support, or leading teams executing government contract

What You'll Do

Tour Planning and Strategy

  • Develop a master schedule, budget, and resourcing plan for the tour, including aircraft transport/ferry logistics, ground support, and personnel deployment to meet the overall mission objectives and success critera.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Business Development, and Government Affairs to prioritization of target locations, stakeholders, and events (e.g., customer demonstrations, government engagements, airshows) across the tour itinerary.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Partner with Flight Test and Engineering teams to ensure the aircraft, crew, and support equipment are mission-ready for each tour stop
  • Coordinate with Legal, Regulatory, and International Trade/Export Control functions to secure necessary permissions, airspace access, and customs clearances for international operations
  • Serve as the central point of coordination between internal teams and external partners, hosts, and government counterparts at each location
  • Manage vendor and logistics partners supporting ground operations, transport, and lodging

Risk Management and Execution

  • Identify, track, and mitigate risks related to schedule, safety, logistics, weather, and geopolitical factors across tour locations
  • Develop contingency plans for schedule disruptions, maintenance needs, or changes in stop-level objectives
  • Monitor tour execution in real time and adjust plans as needed to maintain safety and achieve strategic goals
  • Maintain clear documentation and traceability of decisions, approvals, and changes throughout the tour

Reporting and Communication

  • Provide regular status updates to program and executive leadership on tour progress, risks, and outcomes
  • Capture and communicate lessons learned and stakeholder feedback from each tour stop
  • Support internal and external communications/marketing efforts related to the tour
  • Deliver a post-tour summary with key outcomes, metrics, and recommendations for future campaigns

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience (advanced degree a plus)
  • US Persons required
  • 8+ years in program or project management, ideally within aerospace, defense, or a related complex technical industry
  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with tight schedules and significant logistical coordination
  • Experience working with international operations, export control considerations, and cross-border logistics
  • Strong organizational and risk management skills, with the ability to adapt plans quickly in dynamic environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, flight test, legal, and business teams
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience engaging with government and/or customer audiences
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally, potentially for extended periods

Bonus Points

  • Experience supporting flight test campaigns, demonstration tours, or airshow operations
  • Familiarity with European aviation regulatory environments and airspace coordination
  • Experience working with government or defense customers internationally
  • Prior experience with aircraft ferry/transport logistics

 

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance; STD, LTD, and life insurance
  • Generous PTO, sick leave, and company holidays
  • Paid winter break
  • 401(k) with immediate vesting
  • Free catered lunches, coffee, snacks, and drinks at our Manassas headquarters
  • Free on-site parking

Electra is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This position may be subject to ITAR requirements.

People Leadership: Line-manage and develop a small team of strategists – setting objectives, coaching, reviewing work, and raising the commercial literacy and craft standard across the team.

description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

The Mission Optimization team is responsible for continuously improving the operations and productivity of the world’s largest Earth observation satellite constellation. We identify, triage, and resolve the bottlenecks that limit what our fleets can deliver – from contact scheduling and downlink latency, to collection capacity, to concepts of operation for our future missions.

As a Senior Space Systems Engineer on this team you will own the definition of novel concepts of operations. You will take problems that begin as a customer commitment, a contractual obligation, or an unexploited spacecraft capability, and turn them into an operational concept that engineering teams can build and operators can run.

You will operate with substantial latitude, working closely with spacecraft and systems engineering groups to understand what current and future fleets are capable of, with the software and operations teams who build and run the systems you're changing, and with Product and customer-facing teams to stay anchored to commitments and SLA risk. Being effective across those boundaries is a core part of this job.

  This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Define and own concepts of operations for new missions, new spacecraft capabilities, and new customer products, from early design through nominal operations
  • Lead optimization initiatives that span multiple organizations – setting the technical direction, building agreement, and holding the outcome against fleet SLAs and KPIs
  • Serve as a primary technical interface for the team with stakeholders across engineering, operations, and product
  • Translate contractual and customer obligations into operational concepts and capacity commitments the fleet can actually meet
  • Model and analyze fleet performance with operational data to identify where capacity, latency, or agility are being left on the table
  • Design, develop, and maintain the software solutions that implement these concepts
  • Act as a recognized subject-matter expert across Planet and provide technical mentorship within the team

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in spacecraft operations, mission systems engineering, or a closely related field
  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Ownership of concepts of operations for complex operational systems, from definition to implementation
  • Working proficiency in Python or a comparable language, ability to model systems, analyze operational data, and contribute production code
  • Quantitative approach, including statistical analysis and reasoning over large operational datasets
  • A track record of leading technical initiatives across organizational boundaries
  • Ability to communicate and negotiate technical positions with senior stakeholders
  • Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience operating or designing operations for a large-scale satellite constellation
  • Background in optimization, scheduling, or operations research
  • Experience taking a new mission from design through commissioning and nominal operations
  • Familiarity with commercial Earth Observation, tasking, or fulfillment systems
  • Experience in a customer- or partner-facing technical role
  • Familiarity with orbital mechanics, link budgets, and spacecraft resource modeling
  • Experience with DevOps tooling and practices (Git, GitLab, Docker, CI/CD, Linux, Sentry, Datadog)

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.

Benefits While Working at Planet:

These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.

  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off 
  • Employee Wellness Program

  • Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement
  • Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning
  • Equity 
  • Volunteering Paid Time Off

The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.

Germany Salary Range
€86.600—€108.300 EUR

San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Why we care so much about Belonging. 
We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.

description:
P-1127

At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions.

Our engineering teams build highly technical products that fulfill real, important needs in the world. We develop and operate one of the largest scale software platforms. The fleet consists of millions of virtual machines, generating terabytes of logs and processing exabytes of data per day. At our scale, we regularly observe cloud hardware, network, and operating system faults, and our software must gracefully shield our customers from any of the above.

The Delta DML team owns the core write-path operations for Delta Lake, the open-source storage layer behind the Databricks Lakehouse. Our mission is to deliver industry-leading performance and a seamless user experience at massive scale, with most data written in Databricks flowing through our platform.  We drive performance innovations like Low Shuffle Merge and Deletion Vectors and actively contribute to open source efforts to unify Delta and Iceberg formats.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Staff Software Engineer to join our backend team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining robust backend systems that power Databricks workspaces. You will build the next-generation platform for serving workspace assets, ensuring high QPS, low latency, reliable, and performant systems, proactively addressing the future growth challenges. Additionally, as a senior member of the team, you will provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers, contributing to the overall improvement of team coding practices and system designs.

The Impact you will have:

  • Solve real business needs at large scale by applying your software engineering.
  • Low level systems debugging, performance measurement, and optimization on large production clusters.
  • Build architecture design, influence product roadmap, and take ownership and responsibility over new projects.
  • Introduce tools to allow greater automation and operability of services.
  • Use your deep experience to help prevent and investigate production issues.
  • Plan and lead complicated technical projects that work with several teams within the company.
  • Contribute as a technical team lead by mentoring others, lead sprint planning, delegating work and assignments to team members and participate in project planning.

What we look for:

  • 15+ years industry experience building and supporting large-scale distributed systems.
  • Comfortable working towards a multi-year vision with incremental deliverables.
  • Motivated by delivering customer value and impact.
  • Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures and their real-world use cases.
  • Experience driving company initiatives towards customer satisfaction.
  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or related majors, or equivalent experience.

 

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

(Internal Job Title: Senior Value Engineer)

The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation within the FSI sector by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their ecosystems.

The work you’ll do:

  • Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.
  • Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.
  • Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.
  • Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.
  • Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

The qualifications you need:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.
  • AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.
  • Builder Mentality: Comfortable setting your own direction within an account team. Driven to live for customer value, proactively hunting and ideating for highest-impact solutions.
  • Process Improvement & Value Realization: Proven expertise in executing process improvements. 
  • Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating multi-region or business unit transformation programs. Expert at mobilizing VP/Director-level sponsorship. Flawless English and French communication with commanding executive presence.
  • Domain & Industry: Deep understanding of the Finance/Supply Chain domains and FSI trends. You stay continuously updated on business-critical use cases.
  • Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics,  comparable technical degree or a Business/Economics degree paired with a technical minor

 

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You will own the agents, skills and standards that let a tribe of product builders move quickly on payments without the architecture fragmenting. Hotels take payments across regions and through providers that each behave differently, and Payment Interfaces exists to give customers one coherent payment experience on top of several PSPs. Embedded payments at this depth is rare among European SaaS companies, so the problems here are ones few engineers get to work on.

You will be a Staff Engineer in the Payment Interfaces team, part of the Fintech tribe. You will report to the Director of Product and Engineering, sit in the tribe’s leadership group, and work alongside product builders, other staff engineers and product managers. No one reports to you, so your influence comes from the architecture, tools and standards that other people choose to work in.

The team integrates several PSPs depending on region and conditions. When integrations drift apart, builders slow down and quality suffers. This role exists to keep them coherent by encoding what good looks like into tools and agents, so every builder meets the standard by default.

What you would do 

  • Own the tribe’s engineering agents, skills and context, and encode architectural standards, review logic and quality gates into them so the standard is met by default.

  • Keep Payment Interfaces integrations coherent as PSPs and regional requirements change, collaborating with builders who own their own work.
  • Coach builders and fix off-standard outcomes at the cause, so the lesson sticks.

AI Fluency Level 4: in this role, that means you build the AI systems the tribe works in, not only use them. You design the agents, skills and evaluations that builders rely on every day, make the engineering decisions about how they behave, and set the rules for when an AI answer can stand and when a person must step in.

Nice to have 

  • Experience in hospitality, travel or another operationally complex B2B SaaS environment.
  • Experience publishing or speaking externally about your work.

description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Artefact est une société de conseil et d'ingénierie française spécialisée en data et IA, et leader en Europe, qui depuis plus de 10 ans est spécialisée dans la conception et le déploiement de technologies d’intelligence artificielle et de solutions data-driven. Basé à Paris, nous sommes aujourd’hui présents dans 27 pays sur tous les continents et comptons 2500 collaborateurs. 

Notre mission est d’aider les entreprises à exploiter tout le potentiel de l’IA et de la data en développant des solutions sur-mesure adaptées à leurs enjeux métiers. En tant que pionniers dans ce domaine, nous allions expertise technologique et excellence opérationnelle, en collaborant avec les plus grands acteurs du marché. Nos clients couvrent tous les secteurs clés de l’économie – industrie, retail, luxe, grande consommation, santé, finance – et incluent des grands groupes internationaux. 

En tant que Stagiaire Data Consultant, tu seras pleinement intégré(e) à une équipe de consultants. Ton rôle sera d'assister nos clients dans l'élaboration et la mise en œuvre de leur stratégie data, de la phase d'idéation jusqu'à l'implémentation. Tes missions pourront inclure :

  • Cadrage / gestion des projets : interview clients et partenaires, mise en place de workshops, préparation des uses cases…
  • Construction de roadmaps, d’analyses data-driven avec l’équipe projet et conception d'infrastructures en collaboration avec nos experts 
  • Orchestration du bon déroulement du projet, en appliquant le cas échéant les méthodes agiles (sprints planning et reviews, backlog refinement, démos…) 
  • Veille technologique et sectorielle : rester à l'affût des dernières tendances en matière de data et d'intelligence artificielle pour proposer des solutions innovantes.
  • Communication : Préparer des présentations et des supports de communication pour les comités de direction et les équipes clientes.

Processus de recrutement 

Étape 1 : Entretien RH avec notre chargée de recrutement, Anouk. Le but de cet entretien est de faire votre connaissance, de nous parler de vos expériences professionnelles, vos envies et d'en savoir plus sur votre intérêt pour le conseil et Artefact (45 minutes)

Étape 2 : entretien de type business case avec un senior Data Consultant. Le but de cet entretien est de tester vos méthodes et capacités déductives, votre capacité à résoudre un problème et de confirmer votre intérêt pour Artefact (1 heure) 

Étape 3 : deuxième entretien de type business case avec un manager Data Consultant. Le but de cet entretien est de tester vos méthodes et capacités déductives, votre capacité à résoudre un problème et de confirmer votre intérêt pour Artefact (1 heure) 

Profil recherché

  • Formation : tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur ou au sein d'une grand école de commerce avec une spécialisation en Data, Conseil, ou Management de l'Innovation et tu recherches ton stage de fin d'études à partir de Janvier 2027
  • Compétences :
    • Fort intérêt pour la Data Science et les technologies de la donnée. Tu n'es pas nécessairement un(e) expert(e) technique, mais tu comprends les concepts clés de l'IA, du machine learning, de la Business Intelligence, et du Big Data.
    • Excellentes compétences analytiques et de synthèse.
    • Maîtrise avancée de la suite Microsoft Office (en particulier PowerPoint et Excel).
    • Une connaissance de SQL/Python ou d'un outil de visualisation de données (Power BI, Tableau) est un plus.
  • Qualités personnelles :
    • Sens de la communication et du relationnel : Tu es capable de t'exprimer clairement et de t'adapter à différents interlocuteurs.
    • Proactivité et autonomie : Tu es force de proposition et prends des initiatives.
    • Rigueur et organisation : Tu es capable de gérer plusieurs tâches et de respecter les délais.
    • Français courant pour travailler en équipe et anglais professionnel obligatoire pour nos clients internationaux 

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un stage de 6 mois basé à Paris.
  • Un environnement de travail stimulant au sein d'une équipe dynamique et experte.
  • L'opportunité de travailler sur des projets concrets avec des entreprises de premier plan.
  • La possibilité d'être embauché(e) en CDI à la fin du stage.

Si tu es passionné(e) par la data et que tu souhaites développer une double compétence en conseil et en technologie, envoie-nous ta candidature !

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte. Le groupe s'engage à reconnaître et promouvoir tous les talents, quels que soient leurs croyances, âge, handicap, parentalité, origine ethnique, nationalité, identité de genre, orientation sexuelle, appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité, ou toute autre caractéristique qui pourrait faire l'objet d'une discrimination.

We connect people with possibilities and opportunities across 130+ airports in 34 countries through ground handling, cargo, travel, and catering & retail services. Over de rol Een goede stage kan het begin zijn van een mooie carrière. Als Stagecoördinator bij dnata Passenger Services speel jij een belangrijke rol in het creëren van een leerzame, veilige en succesvolle stageperiode. Je vormt de verbindende schakel tussen stagiairs, onderwijsinstellingen, recruitment en de operationele leidinggevenden. Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de stageperiode: je signaleert talent en helpt geschikte stagiairs hun weg te vinden naar een mogelijke functie binnen dnata. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan de ontwikkeling van jonge professionals, maar ook aan de toekomstige personeelsbezetting en talentontwikkeling van Passenger Services! Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Instroom en introductie: Je brengt de behoefte aan stagiairs en de beschikbare begeleidingscapaciteit in kaart. Je voert sollicitatiegesprekken, stemt de selectie en plaatsing af met Recruitment en leidinggevenden en coördineert de introductie, trainingen en stageafspraken. Begeleiding en ontwikkeling: Je stelt samen met stagiairs en onderwijsinstellingen leerdoelen op, voert regelmatig voortgangsgesprekken en coacht stagiairs tijdens hun stage. Ook organiseer je tussentijdse evaluaties en eindevaluaties en beoordeel je stageopdrachten en eindverslagen. Relatiebeheer en samenwerking: Je onderhoudt contacten met onderwijsinstellingen, bespreekt stagevoorwaarden en evaluatiemomenten en onderzoekt mogelijkheden om het netwerk van dnata uit te breiden. Daarnaast vertegenwoordig je dnata op stagebeurzen en open dagen. Talentontwikkeling en doorstroom: Je volgt de stage-ervaring en toekomstwensen van stagiairs, signaleert mogelijke uitval en onderzoekt de redenen voor voortijdig vertrek. Je adviseert Duty Managers en Recruitment over geschikte kandidaten voor een dienstverband en coördineert de overdracht na afloop van de stage. Monitoring en verbetering: Je houdt gegevens bij over instroom, lopende stages, afronding, uitval en doorstroom. Je rapporteert over de voortgang en begeleidingscapaciteit, signaleert knelpunten en doet voorstellen om het stageproces continu te verbeteren. Wat breng je mee? Vereisten: Mbo 4 werk- en denkniveau. Een relevante opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in luchtvaartdienstverlening, personeelsmanagement of begeleiding en coaching. Ervaring met het begeleiden en coachen van stagiairs of medewerkers binnen Aviation. Ervaring met het voeren van sollicitatie-, voortgangs- en beoordelingsgesprekken. Je beschikt over goede coachingsvaardigheden en weet anderen te motiveren in hun ontwikkeling. Kennis van stageprocessen, leerdoelen en de samenwerking met onderwijsinstellingen. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en weet op een consequente en rechtvaardige manier richting te geven. Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van zowel het Nederlands als het Engels. Wat bieden wij? Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw ervaring en conform de CAO WPBL. Eventuele onregelmatigheidstoeslagen volgens de CAO WPBL. 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld. Reiskostenvergoeding conform de CAO WLVA, gratis busvervoer en parkeermogelijkheden. Een goede pensioenregeling, waarbij dnata bijdraagt aan jouw pensioenopbouw. Opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden via de dnata Training Academy. Klaar om het verschil te maken? Solliciteer vandaag nog en word onderdeel van dnata Nederland!
