description: Signicatis a pan-European digital identity company that makes it easy and safe for organisations to know who they are interacting with online. Using our proprietary technology, we help companies and public organisations securely verify the identities of people and businesses, authenticate users, and enable compliant electronic document signing, so their customers can access services and complete online processes with confidence. Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale. Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world. About the Role Imagine a software development environment where AI agents can collaborate, plan complex tasks, write code, run tests, and help engineers turn ideas into working software. That's what we're building. As a Platform Engineer in Signicat's AI Foundations team, you'll help design and build our internal AI Software Factory: a platform that enables teams of autonomous AI agents to work together, interact securely with our systems, and accelerate how we build software. This isn't just about integrating LLM APIs. We're building the foundations for agent-driven software engineering, tackling challenges around orchestration, distributed execution, state management, sandboxing, security, and human-agent collaboration. Our platform runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes, with Go as our primary programming language. You'll join a team exploring the boundaries of what's possible with AI agents, combining experimentation with solid software engineering principles to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, production-ready systems. How You'll Make An Impact Build the AI Software Factory: Design and develop the core services, APIs, and infrastructure that enable AI agents to plan, execute, and collaborate on complex software engineering tasks. Orchestrate intelligent agents: Build systems that coordinate multiple specialized agents, manage dependencies, schedule work, and support long-running, asynchronous workflows. Design reliable agent runtimes: Develop secure, stateful execution environments that manage agent lifecycles, context, tool invocations, retries, recovery, and execution isolation. Make autonomous execution safe: Implement sandboxing, fine-grained permissions, and security boundaries that allow agents to interact with code, tools, and internal systems without compromising security. Connect agents to the real world: Integrate LLMs, development workflows, internal APIs, and external tools through secure, extensible interfaces and emerging standards such as MCP and A2A. Enable human-agent collaboration: Help create systems where engineers can guide, supervise, and collaborate with autonomous agents, maintaining control over important decisions. Shape the future of AI engineering: Evaluate emerging technologies, challenge existing approaches, experiment with new architectural patterns, and help define how autonomous software engineering evolves at Signicat. Solve interesting engineering problems: Apply your understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, fault tolerance, and software architecture to challenges that don't always have established solutions. Why We'll Love You You have strong software engineering experience, ideally with Go, and enjoy building robust backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. You're comfortable working with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure, ideally on Google Cloud Platform. You think beyond individual services and understand how to design systems that handle concurrency, failures, asynchronous execution, and complex state transitions. You care about clean architecture, well-designed APIs, maintainable code, and automated testing. You understand the importance of security, particularly around authentication, authorization, isolation, and executing untrusted workloads. You're curious about LLMs and autonomous agents, including concepts such as tool calling, context management, multi-agent collaboration, and agent orchestration. You enjoy exploring emerging technologies, experimenting with new approaches, and turning promising ideas into practical solutions. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of challenging technical problems, and helping shape architectural decisions. You enjoy sharing knowledge, collaborating with others, and challenging assumptions to find better solutions. Bonus Points You've built systems using agent frameworks such as Google ADK, or worked with protocols like MCP or A2A. You have experience with sandboxing or workload isolation technologies such as gVisor, WebAssembly, or container-based execution environments. You've worked with event-driven architectures, workflow engines, distributed schedulers, or systems supporting long-running processes. You've experimented with AI coding agents, autonomous development workflows, or multi-agent systems. You have experience designing secure integrations with external services, including OAuth and delegated authorization. You've explored graph-based architectures, RDF, SPARQL, or event-driven systems, and are excited about using these concepts to model complex relationships, agent workflows, and dynamic, reactive applications. This is a wish list, not a checklist. You don't need to have worked with every technology or built AI agents before. If you're a strong engineer who loves solving complex problems and is excited about shaping the future of AI-driven software development, we'd love to hear from you. What we offer: Tailored benefits package by location - we aim to empower our employees by offering customised benefits suited to each market Your tech, your way - choose the tech gear that aligns with your comfort and meets your preferences Remote work style -while you embrace a remote environment, we support occasional in-person gatherings to strengthen the teamwork Work-life balance - enjoy an extra 5 paid days off annually, and we make sure to celebrate your work anniversaries to acknowledge the milestones you achieve Health & Wellness - we prioritise your physical and mental well-being by providing designated packs and access to the Headspace app Continuous growth - quarterly development talks, a dedicated time during working hours each week for training and development, access to Udemy courses, defined career paths, and internal mentorship opportunities Customised onboarding - we will prepare an Onboarding Plan to ensure an easy and smooth beginning Be part of an international team - the opportunity to work from any other Signicat office for 2 months per year and 3 weeks per year from any EU country Empowering feedback culture - by using employee engagement tools, we ensure that every voice is heard, empowering us to grow together Meet-ups - frequent office gatherings and biennial Kick-off event to bring every Signicat under one roof that you don’t want to miss Salary: €70,000-€90,000 gross yearly. We are open to discussing the salary based on your skills and competencies. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Develop dashboards and analyses to surface business-critical KPIs and assess sales and marketing performance. Perform ad-hoc reporting and deep dives to uncover key insights across programs and initiatives to inform strategy and decision making. Partner with marketing stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable data models and analytics-ready datasets. Expert in SQL, python, DBT and visualization platforms (Tableau preferred). Hands-on experience working with Databricks (or similar lakehouse architectures) to transform and model large datasets. Experience building data backends, semantic layers, and structured documentation optimized for AI ingestion and agentic workflows. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with experience in data analysis. Comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate data transformation, analysis, and visualization workflows. Experience supporting Sales, Product or Marketing teams. An ideal candidate also has: Experience building interactive applications using Streamlit or Claude workflows. Experience building web applications Experience working in web analytics Sales and marketing experience including familiarity with MarTech tools. Navigate large, multifaceted datasets to answer hard questions — drawing on the right analytical or statistical approach for each problem. Data Science, machine learning or predictive analytics experience. Actively builds AI fluency relevant to BI and analytics work, including prompt engineering for data tasks, exploring AI-assisted features in tools, and staying current on how AI is reshaping the analytics landscape. Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies. The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. description: About Juniper Square Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. About your role Sitting within Corporate Marketing, the SEO & AEO Manager owns Juniper Square's visibility across organic search, AEO, and GEO: how we're found, ranked, and cited, in traditional search and in the AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) that GPs and fund operations teams increasingly use to research vendors and ideas. Working across the broader GTM organization, you'll set the strategy, then own execution end to end, from technical foundation to AI visibility to authority building. GPs come to Juniper Square for software, for fund administration services, or increasingly both, and each entry point carries its own nuance (terminology, competitive set, audience expectations, etc.) so your strategy has to flex across the full platform rather than run one generic playbook. AEO and GEO add another layer: there's no industry-established playbook yet, and you're expected to help write one for Juniper Square rather than just execute someone else's. The right candidate uses AI as standard infrastructure and pairs technical rigor with the discipline to build processes that compound over time. The application deadline for this role is October 5th, 2026. What you’ll do Own Technical SEO Success here means organic traffic and rankings grow measurably against a defined set of priority terms across Juniper Square's full platform. Own SEO across junipersquare.com: on-page optimization, site architecture, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, and regular technical audits, partnering with our web engineering agency to scope and ship fixes. Monitor and improve sitewide crawl efficiency and indexing. Manage structured data (JSON-LD) and emerging AI crawling protocols, including llms.txt and plain-text/markdown alternates of priority pages. Own the brief and quality bar for agency and vendor relationships across SEO, AEO, and content production, deciding what stays in-house. Monitor Juniper Square's rankings against named competitors, in both traditional search and AI answer engines. When a competitor overtakes us on a priority term, diagnose why and drive the fix, whether that's a technical change, a content update, or an authority play. Win Citations Across the Open Web Success here means Juniper Square gets cited by name in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Google AI Overviews for the private markets questions that matter, tracked against named competitors. Optimize content for LLM and AI-search visibility: schema and structured data, answer-first formatting, and semantic reinforcement that makes Juniper Square content easy for AI systems to extract and cite. Extend that visibility beyond junipersquare.com to Reddit threads, YouTube (titles, descriptions, chapters, and metadata built to rank in video results), review sites, and other community content LLMs treat as trusted sources, and direct that content to work for two readers at once, crawlers and humans, using AI-assisted workflows to scale production without lowering the quality bar. Contribute to the broader social content strategy, including LinkedIn, so format and structure support search and AI-citation goals across channels, not just engagement. Run controlled experiments to isolate what actually moves AI citations rather than treating AEO as guesswork, and turn what you learn into a repeatable playbook. Track how AI platforms retrieve, summarize, and attribute Juniper Square content, report regularly on citation share alongside organic traffic and rankings, and use that data to reprioritize the roadmap. Treat technical SEO and GEO as one program with shared priorities instead of running them as separate workstreams. Build Category Authority Success here means referring domains and citations from private markets and financial media keep growing: real evidence Juniper Square is gaining authority on private markets ideas, not just its own product terms. Build Juniper Square's authority on the ideas that define private markets, not just on product and brand terms, so we're the source search engines and AI systems point to on GP operations, fund administration, and other core private markets topics. Tailor authority-building work to how a GP is engaging us, whether that's software, fund administration, or both, since the competitors and publications that matter shift with the entry point. Partner with content and subject-matter experts to identify where Juniper Square should be the definitive answer to a private markets question but isn't yet, and close those gaps. Qualifications 5+ years in SEO, including hands-on ownership of a technical SEO program at a large B2B organization. Real, hands-on AEO/GEO experience, not just familiarity with the concept. You should be able to point to a specific citation you've earned in an AI answer engine and explain exactly how you did it. A track record of earning backlinks and media citations built on original research or data, not outreach templates alone. Experience with SEO/GEO tooling, including rank trackers, log-file analysis, and AI-citation monitoring platforms. Plus hands-on experience with AEO/GEO or AI-citation monitoring tools, such as Profound, Airops, etc. Enough technical fluency with structured data and schema markup (JSON-LD) to spec work precisely and partner directly with engineers on implementation. Strong writing and editorial judgment: this role often means shaping how a piece of content is framed and structured, not just tagging it after the fact. Comfort operating with real ambiguity. AEO/GEO best practices are still being defined industry-wide, and this role is as much about building Juniper Square's playbook as running it. Experience optimizing social media and video content for search. Experience in financial services, fintech, or private markets, or a demonstrated ability to get up to speed quickly on a technical, regulated industry. description: About Sayari: Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv. About the Role Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do. The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard. You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it. Why This Role Exists Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same. Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it. Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can. What You Will Do Own the analytical relationship, end to end Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering. Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training. Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal. Build with Field Engineering and Product Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission. When something built for one customer should be rebuilt for many, make the case to Product with evidence: the problem, the workaround, and the customers who share it. Document where the platform falls short of the mission, with raw examples attached. Deliver analyst-plus-AI, and teach it Direct Superconductor against live mission problems. Validate its reasoning against expert standards, and extend it into new customer workflows. Train and certify customer analysts on Sayari methods and on working with Superconductor. Identify the customer experts who should go further. Build the tradecraft Capture the judgment calls, non-obvious pivots, and creative approaches from live engagements. Contribute them to the Tradecraft team as expert-annotated reference cases, eval scenarios, and training material. Hold your work to the Field Intelligence standard, and help raise it. Support Go-To-Market Teams Work with Sales to diagnose customer problems, scope solutions, and deliver mission impact. Who You Are Required A builder’s temperament and comfort with ambiguity. You do well on small teams with end-to-end ownership and no defined lane, working next to engineers on things that don’t exist yet. Experience conducting complex, multi-source investigations in one or more of these areas: financial crime, sanctions and export controls, supply chain and forced labor risk, transnational criminal organizations, or law enforcement and intelligence investigations. This should include work with corporate records, trade data, and OSINT. Customer-facing range. You have scoped engagements, demonstrated capability to skeptical experts, and delivered under a statement of work. Candidates often come from solutions consulting, services delivery, embedded analytics, or mission-support roles. Hands-on fluency directing and evaluating AI and agentic analytical tools. You can define what “right” looks like precisely enough to test against. Clear communication with analysts, program managers, engineers, and executives. Desired Python or SQL for data manipulation, and familiarity with REST APIs. Experience designing training curricula or certifying analysts. For government portfolios: an active Government security clearance and same citizenship as your country of residence. Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

An overview of this role As a Staff Backend Engineer in GitLab's Performance Enablement group, you'll define and build the self-serve platform that lets GitLab engineering teams own their performance. You'll give internal teams the tooling and guidance to run performance tests, analyze results, track trends, and meet their own performance requirements throughout the development lifecycle. We're a platform, not a consulting service: we build capabilities that teams use independently to deliver a reliable, performant GitLab to customers. In this hands-on technical leadership role, you'll work with the Engineering Manager to shape a multi-quarter vision and roadmap, bringing your performance engineering expertise to influence teams across research and development (R&D). Some examples of our projects in Performance Enablement: Building reusable component-level testing, load testing, performance analysis, trend visibility, and artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted engineering skills Enabling teams to test performance throughout the development lifecycle, from local development and continuous integration (CI) workflows through pre-release validation, including modular feature teams' own workflows What you’ll do Define the team's technical vision and multi-quarter roadmap with the Engineering Manager, identify opportunities for impact across R&D, and advocate for technical priorities with stakeholders. Design and build reusable platform capabilities for performance testing, analysis, reporting, and trend visibility, solving complex technical problems and shipping large capabilities with minimal guidance. Turn lessons from early team engagements into reusable capabilities, documentation, and onboarding, measured by each new team needing less hands-on support than the last until teams can adopt the platform and manage their performance independently. Coordinate with peer teams across Developer Experience, Infrastructure Platforms, and product groups to align priorities and timing. Lead AI-first development practices in how we build and what we ship, including AI skills and agent-assisted performance workflows. Mentor engineers in performance engineering, platform design, and technical decision-making. Serve as a performance expert for other teams and provide technical guidance on initiatives spanning multiple groups. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it. What you’ll bring Staff-level backend or platform engineering experience, including setting technical direction across a team and the teams around it. A track record of building and operating performance testing and analysis systems, with an understanding of where bottlenecks appear and how to find them. Experience leading or anchoring a performance enablement or platform function and achieving measurable adoption of internal tooling by influencing engineers and leaders who don't report to you. Experience defining and delivering a multi-quarter technical strategy or roadmap with engineering leadership. An AI-first development mindset demonstrated across the software lifecycle, including shaping how a team uses AI. Hands-on experience with load and performance testing tools such as k6 or equivalent, Kubernetes, and Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or similar cloud infrastructure. Clear written, asynchronous communication, including explaining performance trade-offs to engineers and leadership. We work asynchronously and collaborate broadly across R&D, coordinating with peer platform and product groups. Documentation, onboarding, and feedback loops help us turn early team engagements into capabilities that scale beyond individual teams. description: Meet Yubico Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore. Why Join Our Mission? At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of Speed with Integrity, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values: Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience. Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult. One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together. Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program, offering free open-source repositories, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program. At Yubico, we offer: Yubico Values: We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work here). Social Connection: Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our Life at Yubico Page on LinkedIn and our awards here. The Role Yubico is looking for an experienced and highly collaborative Senior Product Manager to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Tools, Libraries, and Applications (TLA) that underlie many of Yubico products and services. In this role, you will be a technical leader in our product management team and work closely with builders across a variety of our products from open source libraries and SDKs which empower other developers to create amazing things with our products, command line tools for managing and using YubiKeys and YubiHSMs, as well as graphical apps for mobile and desktop platforms. Our team works with authentication protocols like FIDO2/WebAuthn and uses cryptography to implement open standards. You'll have the opportunity to help us showcase our libraries in sample apps, making complex topics easier to use. You will help define and deliver the success of Yubico’s foundational product areas and expand the use of our technology to new and innovative areas that capture the market demand. You will serve as the strategic counterpart to our Senior Director of Engineering for Tools, Libraries & Apps. This role will own the "what" and "why" behind the enterprise-grade, secured, and reliable software used to build new applications and services that expand the value of Yubico hardware and services. To succeed, you will work closely with other product managers, engineers, solutions engineers, and operations teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into a robust definition for the foundational tools, libraries and applications in our expanding product portfolio Tasks & Responsibilities Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership: Define and execute the long-term product vision and roadmap for our foundational tools, libraries, and applications, ensuring tight alignment with overarching business goals and customer needs. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply across Engineering, Product, Operations, and Security teams to design high-impact capabilities that enhance product foundations that underlie efficiency and scalability of our solutions. Customer focus: Meet with customers to understand market demand and outcomes for new products Requirements Definition: Translate complex workflows and software requirements into clear, high-quality product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories. Technical Partnership & Conflict Resolution: Serve as the strategic unifier in cross-functional technical decisions. Actively synthesize competing priorities between product vision and architectural necessity, ensuring trade-offs are documented, data-backed, and optimized for long-term reliability. Data-driven Insights: Provide data-driven insights on the specific products being managed, including sales and financial performance, year-over-year trends, pipeline, etc. Full life cycle management: Manage the full life-cycle of a product from inception to end of life including: conception, market and requirements gathering, customer validation, creation of high-quality requirements document, management of engineering, marketing preparation, release and end-of-life processes Security & Compliance Management: Collaborate with security and engineering teams to ensure software systems seamlessly integrate with critical cryptographic infrastructure (such as PKI and HSMs) while maintaining Yubico's gold standard of security. Basic Qualifications Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Experience: 10+ years of progressively broadening product management experience, with a strong track record of shipping complex, enterprise-class hardware & manufacturing solutions. Domain Expertise: Proven experience in technical product management including development of large-scale internal tools. Leadership & Acumen: Proven ability to act as a constructive challenger to highly technical engineering partners. Strong business and technical acumen with the confidence to debate architectural tradeoffs and act as a constructive challenger in deeply technical environments and manage competing priorities across geographically distributed teams. Communication: Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills to align multi-disciplinary teams toward a unified vision. Preferred Qualifications Cryptographic Systems: Understanding of cryptographic systems, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), or Key Management Systems utilizing Hardware Security Modules (HSMs). Analytical Mindset: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to diving deep into technical workflows alongside engineering teams. We pay 100% of your premium and 85% for your family. Retirement plan. Our retirement plan includes a 401K dollar per dollar match up to 6% with a cap of $6K/year. Immediate vesting. Wellness reimbursement. We offer $1,200.00 in wellness earnings (prorated based on start date) that you can use on your gym membership, a massage, or your favorite online fitness classes. Job Summary: As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our AI Solutions business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges through forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software and platforms, AI services, and AI-enabled transformation. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients move from AI strategy and experimentation into production, combining Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to achieve measurable business outcomes. This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who have successfully sold enterprise AI solutions and are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives. Enterprise AI has shifted rapidly from experimentation to execution. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes. The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production. Toptal brings together world-class AI and domain talent, forward-deployed solution delivery, AI platforms and capabilities, strategic technology partners, expert-in-the-loop operations, and managed services to help enterprises move from AI promise to production. This role exists to convert that market opportunity into new enterprise relationships and position Toptal as a strategic partner for companies deploying AI across their organizations. This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. description: What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements. We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here. Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future. How you’ll demonstrate Ownership Client Engagement & Moving Strategy to Reality: Partner with Account Executives to prioritize strategic opportunities and act as the technical lead for complex engagements. You will move clients from high-level strategy to live, functioning versions of Cognite’s solutions through Fast AI Prototyping via Cognite Atlas AI™ and Cognite Data Fusion®. Agentic Solution Development: Lead the design and implementation of first-of-their-kind industrial agents. You will leverage the Atlas AI workbench to automate complex industrial workflows, ensuring solutions are technically feasible, scalable, and grounded in the contextualized data foundation of our Industrial Knowledge Graph. Technical Representation & Use Case Design: Lead use case workshops and briefings, translating functional and non-functional requirements into deliverable high-level use cases. You will build executive confidence by delivering client-focused demos and reference architectures that prove the ROI of Industrial AI. Product Innovation & Field Leadership: Act as the critical bridge between the field and Cognite’s Product organization. Translate "field friction" and deployment learnings into actionable product requirements and scalable best practices that strengthen Cognite’s position as the leader in Industrial DataOps. The Impact you bring to Cognite Industrial Architecture Expertise: Ability to design scalable architectures that unify siloed IT/OT/ET data into a single source of truth using Cognite Data Fusion®. Agentic AI Proficiency: Demonstrated experience building with LLMs (Gemini, Claude, GPT-4) and a deep understanding of the Agentic AI landscape to create trusted, mission-critical industrial agents via Cognite Atlas AI™. Full-Stack Solution Engineering: Ability to orchestrate and build end-to-end prototypes—integrating GenAI components, CDF data models, and legacy customer systems—using scalable software practices and open-source AI frameworks. Technical Evangelism & Strategic Influence: The ability to distill complex technical AI solutions into compelling, value-driven narratives. You can pivot seamlessly between deep architectural sessions with engineers and strategy briefings with C-level executives. Required Qualifications 3+ years in forward deployed engineering/pre-sales engineering roles ideally in enterprise SaaS, cloud platforms, or industrial software companies. Strong engineering background. Preferred fields include but are not limited to Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Machine Learning. A strong foundation in Python and a deep understanding of the GenAI landscape (embeddings, RAG, and prompt chaining). Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. Ability and interest to travel up to 50% as needed to be "on the ground" where the impact happens. Preferred Experience Education or experience in the industrial space (e.g., Petroleum, Chemical, Mechanical, or Control System Engineering). Previous customer facing or sales experience. You’ve worked with "messy" real-world variables from the Industries we work in (Energy, Oil and Gas, Chemicals, Life Sciences, Discrete) and understand, for example, why data quality in a refinery is harder than data quality in a web app. You are excited to bridge the gap between traditional heavy industry and the future of Autonomous Operations via Cognite Data Fusion® and Agentic AI. A snapshot of our many perks and benefits as a Cogniter Competitive compensation 401(k) with employer matching Competitive health, dental, vision & disability coverages for employees and all dependents Unlimited PTO Paid Parental Leave Program Employee Referral Program Learn more about us Impact 2025 Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi. Equal Opportunity Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. As a Senior Data Engineer on the Graph Analytics team, you will build scalable graph systems that analyze large networks of cryptocurrency transactions. You will collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists, and investigators to design mission-critical graph algorithms that analyze flows of funds. You will leverage distributed databases and graph processors to implement real-time graph algorithms at the multi-blockchain scale. You will collaborate with data science teams to identify opportunities to apply tools and techniques from graph theory to a variety of predictive learning problems. The impact you will have: Designing and implementing graph algorithms that analyze large cryptocurrency transaction networks at multi-blockchain scale Researching new graph-native technology to evaluate benefit to data science and data engineering teams at TRM Working on a highly cross-functional team that collaborates with cryptocurrency investigators to identify key user stories and requirements for new graph algorithms and features Understanding and refining TRM’s risk models which analyze large networks of cryptocurrency transactions to assign risk scores to addresses Communicating complex implementation details to a variety of audiences from investigators and customer success stakeholders to data engineers and data scientists Integrating with a diverse set of data inputs ranging from raw blockchain data to complex model outputs What we’re looking for: Your academic background is in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or Physics. You have strong knowledge of algorithm design and data structures, and have experience applying this knowledge towards real-world problems. You have experience optimizing large-scale distributed data processing systems such as Apache Spark, Apache Hadoop, Dask, and distributed graph databases. You have experience converting academic research into products and have worked with research teams that regularly ship new features. You have strong programming experience with Python and SQL. You are an excellent communicator who is skilled at tailoring explanations of complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences. You are self-motivated. You propose and validate solutions with minimal guidance. You're comfortable working with ambiguity and shaping your own research direction while being accountable for outcomes. You are knowledgeable of basic graph theory concepts. About the Team: Our team is spread out over several countries and time zones. To leverage the opportunities and address challenges that come with this working model, we've built a culture grounded in trust, transparency, and adaptability. Even though we're scattered across different time zones, we stay closely connected through open communication and regular check-ins. Our use of digital tools helps us collaborate seamlessly and work at an impressive pace, delivering results at TRM speed while staying in sync. The diversity of perspectives and expertise within our team sparks creative exchanges and enhances our problem-solving capabilities, allowing us to leverage our global synergy to drive innovation and efficiency. We're driven by a deep sense of ownership, constant pursuit of improvement and an obsession with delivering magical experiences to our customers; these are a core part of our culture. We're driven by the desire to continuously hone our craft and to this end, we regularly assess our processes, seek feedback, and embrace iterative development to refine what we do. We structure problems and use the 80/20 rule(for many outcomes, roughly 80% of consequences come from 20% of causes) to identify where to direct our razor-sharp focus. Each of us is passionate about excellence and growth, and we're encouraged to challenge the status quo and experiment with new methods. This mindset creates an environment where innovation is part of our daily routine and every team member is an impact-oriented trailblazer. By celebrating our successes and learning from our setbacks, we stay agile and forward-thinking, always striving to elevate our performance and impact. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: The team received a request from customers to show the running balance for assets tied to an address within the product. They brainstormed to determine the minimal viable solution that could be delivered within two weeks. The team decided to develop a framework that would facilitate enabling this feature for each chain (such as BTC, ETH, etc.) individually. They successfully implemented and tested this solution for the BTC chain and delivered it to customers within the two-week timeframe. This approach allowed the team to quickly provide value to customers and establish a repeatable process. The team was tasked with implementing a new feature that would enable TRM to gather feedback from the user community swiftly. Due to the company's goal of showcasing the feature at an upcoming event, the timeline was tight. The team quickly adjusted to the request, assessed the requirements, and developed a solution that addressed 80% of the needs and could be executed within a very short timeframe. They successfully delivered the feature on schedule, impressing customers with both the functionality and the speed of execution. The team was tasked with developing a solution to reveal Indirect Exposure through cross-chain swaps in response to a competitor's similar feature. Before choosing the technical approach, the team consulted with stakeholders to establish a feasible timeline for the implementation. With this input, the team devised a solution that fit the timeline, communicated the tradeoffs to stakeholders, and successfully delivered the solution as promised. Work Week Travel: This role requires participation in in-person R&D work weeks, typically 1–2 times per quarter, at a TRM hub or other designated location. Work weeks may be scheduled with as little as 14 days’ notice, and some roles may require additional travel based on team and cross-functional needs. TRM coordinates and covers approved travel, lodging, and workspace. Accommodations are available for legitimate caregiving, health, immigration, and similar constraints. About TRM's Engineering Levels: Engineer: Responsible for helping to define project milestones and executing small decisions independently with the appropriate tradeoffs between simplicity, readability, and performance. Provides mentorship to junior engineers, and enhances operational excellence through tech debt reduction and knowledge sharing. Senior Engineer: Successfully designs and documents system improvements and features for an OKR/project from the ground up. Consistently delivers efficient and reusable systems, optimizes team throughput with appropriate tradeoffs, mentors team members, and enhances cross-team collaboration through documentation and knowledge sharing. Staff Engineer: Drives scoping and execution of one or more OKRs/projects that impact multiple teams. Partners with stakeholders to set the team vision and technical roadmaps for one or more products. Is a role model and mentor to the entire engineering organization. Ensures system health and quality with operational reviews, testing strategies, and monitoring rigor. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. Interviewing with TRM Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview. Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role. Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact. Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details. Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you! Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. AI Fluency at TRM AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: Accelerate repeatable workflows Structure and solve problems Improve output quality Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. Life at TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: Priorities and targets to change quickly Operating with a high degree of ambiguity A high level of personal ownership and accountability Close collaboration across teams and functions Frequent, high-touch communication Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Leadership Principles We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. Join our Mission At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Privacy Policy and Additional Information By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy. We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM. Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law. If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com. To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form. Recruitment agencies TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager for Mexico to own the go-to-market strategy and customer narrative for the Mexican market, working across Samsara’s full product portfolio. This is an audience - and market-led Product Marketing role, not a single-product PMM position. You will focus on shaping how Samsara brings its platform - spanning hardware, software, and AI-powered capabilities - to market for customers in Mexico. This includes adapting global product strategy to local customer needs, buying dynamics, regulatory considerations, and sales motions, with messaging developed for Mexican Spanish-speaking audiences. The role is ideal for a senior PMM who is proactive, enjoys working on open-ended problems, and takes satisfaction in bringing clarity and structure to complex situations. You will act as a key partner to Mexico Sales, Marketing, and regional leadership, working closely with US-based Product and Marketing teams and international Product Marketing leadership. This is a remote role based in Mexico. We have a strong preference for candidates located in Mexico City who can come into our local office as needed. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. In this role, you will: Lead and execute key components of the go-to-market strategy for Samsara’s platform in Mexico, in close partnership with international Product Marketing leadership and local Sales and Marketing teams Adapt global launches, messaging, and positioning for Mexican audiences, ensuring local relevance, Mexican Spanish language quality, and alignment with product availability in Mexico Develop market-specific narratives and Mexican customer proof points that connect multiple products into clear stories focused on customer value; equip Sales with messaging, customer stories, and enablement in Spanish Build working knowledge across Samsara’s full product suite, including hardware, software, and AI-driven capabilities Explore Mexican customer needs, buying dynamics, regulatory considerations, and the competitive landscape to provide fresh insights. Investigate priorities such as driver safety, vehicle and cargo security, fuel efficiency, maintenance, and cross-border operations where relevant to the customer Track go-to-market effectiveness in Mexico, product adoption signals, and local sales feedback Use customer and field insights to refine messaging, positioning, and execution in Mexico, and represent local needs to global Product and Marketing teams Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Minimum requirements for the role: 5 + of Product Marketing experience (or closely related go-to-market) experience, with a meaningful portion in B2B technology, SaaS, or similarly complex environments (experience working in hardware a plus) Excel at customer-centric storytelling, translating technical features into clear value, and eagerly engaging directly with customers. Act as a proactive, resilient self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and takes full ownership to drive complex problems to a solution. Proven track record partnering with Sales and Product in a sales-led GTM motion Comfortable working across multiple product areas rather than owning a single product niche Fluent professional Spanish and English, written and spoken, with the ability to create customer-facing messaging and deliver sales enablement in Spanish Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini) to streamline workflows, draft content, and scale output while maintaining strong editorial judgment. An ideal candidate also has: Experience working for a US-headquartered company Experience supporting the Mexican market, with an understanding of local customer needs, buying processes, and sales-led go-to-market execution Experience in transportation, logistics, distribution, manufacturing, or other industries with physical operations in Mexico; familiarity with cross-border operations is a plus Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. description: About Sayari: Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv. About the Role Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do. The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard. You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. description: For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well. For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you. Angi at a glance: Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021 Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting About the team: At Angi, security is woven into everything we build, from PCI-scoped payment flows to the AI agents now handling homeowner/pro conversations and scheduling end-to-end. Detection signal spans cloud, endpoint, identity, SaaS, and a growing set of autonomous agents. You'll own detection and response as an engineering problem: build the detections, build the automation that works them, and carry the pager for what still gets through. While this is a remote position, we are a global company and are looking for applicants located in eastern or central time zones to align with our team's working hours. What you’ll do: Build and own detections across AWS (GuardDuty, CloudTrail, SecurityHub), EDR, identity, SaaS, and our AI gateway. Coverage, precision, and latency are properties we manage across a rule's lifecycle. Own the security log pipeline, and own it as a product with consumers: audit and security logs land centrally and are exposed to the teams that need them for triage, analysis, and incident response. Own detection on the application protection layer - account takeover, credential stuffing, and abuse patterns against a two-sided marketplace. Build the triage layer - enrichment, correlation, containment, evidence capture - working toward a median alert that resolves without a human touching it. Use LLM and agentic tooling where it earns its place, and own the verification layer that makes that output trustworthy. Buy the tool where a tool is right, build where it isn't, and extend where it's close. You'll ship code in a repo, not only configure consoles. Extend detection coverage to Angi's agentic AI products: what anomalous behavior looks like for an autonomous agent holding calendar and account access - prompt injection attempts, tool-call abuse, data exfiltration through the agent surface. Actively participate in all facets of the incident response lifecycle by participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation. Own the technical controls InfoSec retains for detection within compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS (tamper-detection monitoring, log integrity, alerting coverage). Partner with platform and product teams so new services ship with telemetry, threat models, and response playbooks. You will be in the room when these are designed, not brought in after the fact. Who you are: You have 5+ years of experience working on a security team supporting product/engineering functions, cloud infrastructure, and corporate infrastructure development You have software engineering experience (Python preferred) and an engineering mindset for building reliable / maintainable security infrastructure to support a large organization with CI/CD software engineering practices You are at home in the analytics and observability stack detections get measured on - Grafana, Looker, NewRelic or similar. You will build your own coverage and precision dashboards rather than filing a ticket for them. Hands-on with AWS and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent); working knowledge of EDR, SIEM, and SOAR platforms and their APIs. Hands-on with containers and Kubernetes, including what detection and forensics look like on that surface. Sound build-versus-buy judgment with no allergy to either answer. You reach for what exists when it fits, and you're comfortable wrapping, extending, or replacing it when it doesn't. You've owned incidents end to end - page, diagnosis, fix, postmortem. Some level of exposure to LLM/agentic system security (prompt injection, agent identity, data exfiltration via AI systems). A daily, fluent user of AI-assisted coding/security tools. You are able to speak concretely about how you direct and verify AI output. Strong written communication: you'll write detection documentation, postmortems, and design feedback that other engineers rely on. Comfort executing the technical side of a compliance framework (PCI, SOX, or similar) is preferred. Full medical, dental, vision package to fit your needs. Flexible vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it. Pet discount plans & retirement plan with company match (401K).
